delivery_semantics.idempotency: event_id unique per source event; duplicate delivery safe
delivery_semantics.ordering: source revision or sequence prevents stale event overwrites
delivery_semantics.auth: verify real API token/scope and webhook signatures; never place tokens in payload
delivery_semantics.failure: durable local outbox, bounded retries, visible pending status
delivery_semantics.reconciliation: compare local plan/evidence with remote acknowledgments; unknown is not success

progress.merged: accepted exact commit with required CI and policy evidence
progress.production_verified: deployed accepted commit plus valid current live evidence
